title: Amazon scales rapid delivery ‘Now’ to 300+ cities; launches ‘Sammaan’ program for delivery partner welfare
summary: Things needed quickly, like groceries, shampoo, baby products, get picked and delivered just minutes after being ordered, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said, adding that “customers are loving it...”
